summary: All platforms under 100 followers; Instagram reels lose 77% viewers in first 3 seconds. Question hooks earn 21% of comparison hooks per reach. Bio violates brand rules: niches (hotels, cafes, gyms, homestays), region (Himachal), timeframe (24 hrs), and permanent free offer.
guidance:
- Rotate to **comparison** or **contrast** hooks (question hooks underperform 4.7x vs comparison)
- Avoid "same 5 questions" phrasing — used 3× recently (chatbot posts 10/21, 10/25, 11/02)
- Lead-gen and chatbot topics outperform animated_ads 2.7x per reach; website posts steady
- Posts must read as a developer showing real work, never an ad; no demos, samples, or niche targeting

instructions.research: Find 3 real Indian small-business search queries (e.g. "best gym management software Jaipur", "cafe POS system Bangalore", "clinic appointment booking Delhi") that show local intent and low-quality results — use these as concrete examples in the post.
instructions.analysis: Compare the top 3 ranking pages for each query: note word count, structure, local signals (address, phone, map embed), and gaps a freelancer could fill. Keep notes private; do not publish competitor names.
instructions.writer: Write one Instagram carousel post (5–7 slides) for SEO blog writing service. Hook: comparison — "Posting daily on Instagram vs. publishing one search-optimised blog: what a Delhi gym and a Bangalore cafe actually get from each." Use the 3 researched queries as varied examples. End with pay-after-approval offer and DM-for-advice CTA. No niche targeting, no guarantees.
instructions.image: Create a clean carousel template: slide 1 hook text on neutral background; slides 2–4 each show one query + screenshot of weak SERP (blur brand names); slide 5 "What a proper blog post adds" (bullet list); slide 6 pay-after-approval + DM CTA. No logos, no client names.
instructions.video: Skip video today — reel skip rate 77% indicates hook/format mismatch. Revisit after 3 comparison-hook carousels show engagement.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to: "Websites, AI chatbots, animated ads & SEO blogs for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest advice." (removes niches, region, timeframe, permanent free offer)
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts by Indian freelancers/agencies discussing client acquisition or content marketing — ask a genuine question, don't pitch.
Reply to any story replies or comments on your last 3 posts within 2 hours to boost algorithm signal.
